content.introduction: According to Bloomberg, as of October 5, 2026, the Information Technology sector had the highest weight at 43% and a 0.60% change, followed by Health Care at 11% and 0.60%. The Materials sector had a 4% weight and a 1.40% change. The Consumer Discretionary sector had an 11% weight and a 0.79% change. The Financials sector had a 5% weight and a 0.74% change. The Energy sector had a 6% weight and a 1.09% change. The Communication Services sector had a 3% weight and a 1.07% change. The Utilities sector had a 2% weight and a 0.50% change. The Consumer Staples sector had a 5% weight and a 0.46% change. The Industrials sector had an 8% weight and a 0.39% change. The Real Estate sector had a 2% weight and a 0.36% change. The All Sectors index had a 100% weight and a 0.66% change
